description.value: New Generation Foods is a multicultural natural foods grocery store specializing in staple pantry items — flours, grains, beans, lentils, rice, spices, dried fruit, and nuts — sourced for Latin American, African, Middle Eastern, South Asian, and European communities. The store produces its own Kismet brand of bulk-style dry goods, with a strong emphasis on dietary-restriction-friendly flours (corn, rice, quinoa, sorghum, amaranth, oat, barley, teff). For a touring cyclist, it offers a practical resupply point for high-calorie, lightweight staples at what the store describes as competitive prices.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 40m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms New Generation Foods is an operating multicultural natural foods grocery store carrying staple goods (grains, beans, rice, spices, lentils, dried fruit, nuts) under both third-party and its own Kismet brand. The website footer gives the full address as '7438 Edmonds Street, Burnaby, BC V3N 1A8,' which conflicts with the OSM community field listing 'North Vancouver' — the business is in Burnaby.
